blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Attributing short LLM-generated texts to a specific source remains challenging for existing multi-bit watermarking methods, which often require long generations or costly decoding to recover payloads reliably. We propose a codebook-based watermarking scheme that maps an $n$-bit payload to a longer $u$-bit codeword and embeds it during generation through token-level logit biasing. During extraction, the received bit sequence is matched to the nearest codeword in a precomputed secret codebook using Hamming or Levenshtein distance. Experiments show that our method achieves near-perfect recovery for 16-24 bit payloads on 200-token generations and strong performance on 127-token generations for base models. Results are weaker on some instruction-tuned models with very short texts, where low-entropy output distributions reduce embedding reliability. We also study a BCH-based variant that avoids codebook storage but generally reduces robustness. The Levenshtein variant improves resilience to deletions and light paraphrasing, while insertions and stronger rewrites remain challenging. We analyze collision probability, codeword separation, extraction time, tokenization consistency, and text quality, highlighting both the practicality and limitations of codebook-based watermarking for short-form attribution.
blocks.zh: 将 LLM 生成的短文本归于特定来源对于现有的多位水标记方法来说仍然具有挑战性,这些方法往往需要几代人或昂贵的解码才能可靠地回收有效载荷。 我们提出一个基于密码簿的水标记方案,将一个美元位的有效载荷映射到一个更长的美元位的代码字,并在生成过程中通过符号级的登录偏差嵌入. 在提取过程中,接收到的比特序列被匹配到一个使用汉明或莱文施泰因距离的预计算的秘密密码簿中最接近的密码词. 实验表明,我们的方法实现了200个托肯代上16-24位有效载荷的近乎完美回收,127个托肯代上也实现了强大的性能,用于基础模型. 在一些文本非常短的教学调试模型上,结果较弱,低通量输出分布降低了嵌入可靠性. 我们还研究一种基于BCH的变体,该变体避免了编码本存储,但一般降低稳健性. 莱文施泰因变体提高了对删除和光变异的适应能力,而插入和较强的重写仍然具有挑战性. 我们分析碰撞概率,密码字分离,提取时间,标注一致性,以及文本质量,强调基于密码本的水标记对短式归属的实用性和局限性.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become widely adopted for tasks ranging from content drafting and summarisation to dialogue and code generation. As the quality of machine-generated text has improved, so has the difficulty of distinguishing it from human writing—raising concerns about misuse in misinformation, plagiarism, and large-scale deceptive content such as fake product reviews. Early watermarking methods addressed the detection problem: zero-bit schemes [ 1 , 2 ] embed a statistical signal that allows a verifier to determine whether a given text was produced by an LLM, but they do not carry any identifying information about the source.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)被广泛采用,用于从内容起草和概括到对话和代码生成等任务. 随着机器生成的文本质量的提高,很难将其与人类写作区分开来,使人们对错误信息、盗版行为和大规模欺骗性内容如假产品评论的滥用感到关切。 早期的水分标记方法解决了检测问题:零位方案[1,2]嵌入了一个统计信号,使核查者能够确定某一文本是否由LLM所出出,但是它们并没有携带任何关于源的识别信息.

blocks.en: Multi-bit watermarking goes further by embedding a payload—such as a user or session identifier—directly into the generated token sequence, enabling attribution to a specific source. Several such schemes have since been proposed (see Section II ), yet they are predominantly evaluated on texts of approximately 200 tokens, as longer sequences provide more redundancy for reliable extraction. This leaves the sub-200 token space largely unaddressed. Product reviews, social media posts, and short comments—all common targets for AI-generated deception—routinely fall well below this threshold. Studies estimate that 16–33% of online reviews are inauthentic [ 3 ] , with recent analyses putting this figure at roughly 30% as of 2025, a problem projected to cost hundreds of billions of dollars globally [ 4 ] . Reliably watermarking these short-form texts remains an open and practically important challenge.
blocks.zh: 多位水标记更进一步,将有效载荷——如用户或会话标识符——直接嵌入生成的符号序列中,从而能够归属于某一特定来源。 此后提出了若干这类计划(见第二节),但由于较长的序列为可靠提取提供了更多的冗余,因此主要评价大约200个令牌的文本。 这使200个子符号空间基本上得不到解决。 产品评论、社交媒体文章和简短的评论, 研究估计,16-33%的在线评论不正确[3],最近的分析显示,截至2025年,这一数字约为30%,预计这个问题将在全球耗资数千亿美元。 [4] 对这些短式文本贴上可靠的水印仍然是一项公开和实际上重要的挑战。

blocks.en: II Current Approaches and Limitations
blocks.zh: 二. 现行办法和限制

blocks.en: Several recent works have explored multi-bit watermarking schemes for LLM-generated text beyond the simple zero-bit (detector) watermarks [ 2 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Table I summarizes the performance of representative methods from the literature. Overall, there is a clear trade-off between accuracy and efficiency in existing approaches.
blocks.zh: 最近的一些作品探索了LLM生成的文字的多位水标方案,超越了简单的零位(检测)水标[2,5,6,7,8]. 页:1 我从文献中总结了代表性方法的表现。 总的来说,现有方法的准确性与效率之间有着明显的取舍。

blocks.en: On one end of the spectrum, enumeration-based methods treat message extraction as a search problem, examining many possible bit sequences to find which one was embedded. Fernandez et al. [ 7 ] propose an enumeration approach that achieves very high extraction accuracy (nearly 99% success on 16-bit payloads) by exhaustively searching for the hidden message. However, this comes at the cost of extremely slow decoding: extracting a 32-bit watermark from a single short text was reported to take on the order of 8 hours, making it impractical for large-scale deployment. Another multi-bit method by Wang et al. [ 2 ] improves upon this with a more efficient coding strategy, managing to extract 32-bit messages in about 2.3 hours per text in experiments. While faster, even a two-hour extraction for one short document is far too slow for real-time or mass detection scenarios. Moreover, both of these methods exhibit exponentially growing extraction time as the message length increases, due to their reliance on combinatorial search. This lack of scalability means that although they can reach high accuracy, they are not suitable for embedding more than a handful of bits in short texts.
blocks.zh: 在光谱的一端,基于计数的方法将消息提取作为一个搜索问题,审查许多可能的比特序列来找到哪个是嵌入的. 费尔南德斯等. [7] 提出一个计数法,通过彻底搜索隐藏信息,实现非常高的取出精度(16位有效载荷上接近99%的成功率). 然而,这是以极其缓慢地解码为代价的:据报道,从一则短文中取出一具32位的水印取取出后取出8小时的顺序,使得大规模部署不切实际. 又一多位法由王等所出. [2]用更高效的编码策略改进了这一点,在实验中每个文本大约2.3个小时内设法取出32位的信息. 虽然速度更快,但即使是一个短文档的两小时取出,对于实时或质量检测情景来说也太慢了. 此外,这两种方法都显示,由于信息长度增加,它们依靠组合搜索,因此提取时间呈指数增长。 这种缺乏可缩放性意味着,虽然它们可以达到高精度,但是它们并不适合在短文中嵌入超过少数位.

blocks.en: At the other end of the design spectrum are approaches that prioritize efficiency by avoiding expensive search. A notable example is the method of Yoo et al. [ 5 ] , which uses a position-based token allocation technique to encode bits on the fly during text generation. This approach enables nearly instantaneous extraction as it does not require iterating over candidate messages. However, the drawback is significantly lower accuracy in recovering the full message, especially as the payload size grows. For instance, Yoo et al.’s watermark could only recover a 16-bit message from a short text about 74% of the time, dropping to around 30% success for 24-bit payloads. Such error rates are far from acceptable for reliable tracing—losing even a single bit can corrupt the entire extracted identifier. In summary, purely efficient schemes tend to underperform on short texts, because a short generated passage provides limited opportunities to redundantly encode each bit and ensure error-free decoding.
blocks.zh: 设计频谱的另一端是通过避免昂贵的搜索来优先考虑效率的方法. 一个显著的例子就是"柳等"的方法. [5],它使用基于位置的符号分配技术来在文本生成过程中编码苍蝇上的比特. 这种办法几乎可以立即提取,因为它不需要对候选人信息进行重复。 然而,特别是在有效载荷大小增加的情况下,在恢复全部信息方面,缺点的准确度要低得多。 例如,Yoo等人的水印只能从大约74%的时间的短文本中取出16位信息,24位有效载荷的成功率降至30%左右。 这种出错率对于可靠的追踪来说远不能被接受——连一点都可能损坏所提取的整个识别器。 简而言之,纯粹高效的方案往往在短文本上表现不佳,因为短生成的段落为冗余地将每个位码编码并确保无出错解码提供了有限的机会.

blocks.en: A key observation from Table I is that no existing method meets the > > 98% extraction success criterion on short texts without incurring prohibitive extraction time. The enumeration-based watermark of Fernandez et al. [ 7 ] achieves near-perfect accuracy on short passages, but only by tolerating an infeasible decoding latency. The fast method of Yoo et al. [ 5 ] sacrifices too much accuracy to be useful for robust tracing. Wang et al. ’s [ 2 ] balanced coding strikes a middle ground, but still does not reach the reliability needed for high-stakes use cases. Lin et al. [ 8 ] propose DERMARK , which uses dynamic segment allocation to improve capacity on short texts; in roughly 100-token outputs it reports about 90% success for 24-bit payloads, reducing tokens-per-bit compared to prior art, yet still falling short of the > > 98% target in this regime. Very recently, Qu et al. [ 6 ] introduced a watermarking scheme that combines ideas from both camps—achieving 96–98% extraction success on 20–24 bit messages in ∼ \sim 200-token texts, while keeping extraction time around 1 second. This represents the state of the art to date, yet even this approach sees the success rate dip to 94% for 32-bit payloads in a paragraph of text, and the performance on extremely short texts (e.g., single-sentence inputs) has not been fully demonstrated. In other words, the problem is not completely solved: there remains a practical gap in being able to robustly watermark and decode very short AI-generated texts at scale.

blocks.en: As shown above, existing techniques each fail to fully satisfy the needs of short-text watermarking. An ideal solution would combine the near 100% reliability of exhaustive methods with the speed of lightweight methods. This is precisely the challenge our work tackles.
blocks.zh: 如上所显示,现有的技术都未能充分满足短文水标记的需要。 一个理想的解决办法是将详尽方法的近100%的可靠性同轻量级方法的速度结合起来。 这正是我们的工作所面临的挑战。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Our watermarking scheme. A codebook is pre-generated offline and later used by the embedding and extraction algorithms. The embedding phase embeds a long codeword (e.g., 127 bits) into the generated text. During the extraction, a noisy version of codeword is first obtained and then the closest codeword is searched in the codebook. Once the closest codeword is identified, the corresponding watermark is extracted. The detection decision (watermarked vs. non-watermarked) is based on the distance threshold. A distance is measured by the Hamming or Levenshtein distance.

blocks.en: II-A Contributions
blocks.zh: 捐款

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We developed a novel watermarking scheme with very high extraction success on multi-bit watermarks, even for short AI-generated texts, without sacrificing efficiency. We achieved a very high match rate with a 24-bit payload capacity, even on texts as short as 127 tokens in most settings. Our method also performs well at the standard 200-token evaluation length, matching or outperforming existing approaches. • We showed that our main variant with Levenshtein distance provides a meaningful level of robustness and for some attacks is more robust than the state-of-the-art solutions. • We investigated variants with Hamming and Levenshtein distances, analyzing their codeword collision and separation features. Additionally, we proposed the BCH variant, which does not require a pre-generated codebook. The BCH variant offers longer watermarks at the expense of lower accuracy and robustness.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们开发了一个新的水印方案,在多位水印上取得了非常高的取出成功,即使是短篇AI生成的文本,也不牺牲效率. 我们实现了非常高的匹配率,拥有24位有效载荷能力,甚至在大多数情况下短到127个令牌的文本上也是如此. 我们的方法在标准的200个评价长度、匹配或优于现有方法方面也表现良好。 我们显示,我们与莱文斯提因相距的主要变体提供了有意义的坚固程度,对某些攻击来说,比最先进的解决办法更有力。 我们用汉明和列文斯提因的距离调查了变体,分析它们的密码相撞和分离特征. 此外,我们提出了BCH的变体,不需要预先生成的代码簿. BCH变体提供更长的水印而牺牲了较低的精度和坚固度.

blocks.en: III Multi-bit Watermarking Scheme with Codebook
blocks.zh: III 多位标水方案与代码簿

blocks.en: To overcome the trade-off between accuracy and efficiency, we introduce a novel scheme centered around a pre-computed codebook . Enumeration-based methods can be prohibitively slow not necessarily because they consider more candidate watermarks, but because evaluating each candidate may require expensive decoding. Our method still searches over all 2 n 2^{n} watermark identities, but it reduces extraction to a nearest-neighbor lookup against a precomputed codebook of u u -bit codewords, where distance computations are very cheap and the codewords are well separated. This approach combines the robustness of having a long, redundant signal with the search efficiency, making it ideal for short texts where every token counts.
blocks.zh: 为了克服精度和效率之间的取舍,我们引入了一个以预先计算过的密码本为中心的新方案。 以数字为基础的方法可能令人望而却步,不一定因为它们考虑更多的候选水印,而是因为评价每个候选水印可能需要昂贵的解码. 我们的方法仍在搜索所有 2 n 2^{n 的水印身份, 但是它将提取到一个最近的邻里 查看一个预算的 u-bit 代码词的代码簿, 在那里, 距离计算非常便宜, 代码词被很好的分隔 。 这种方法将长而冗余的信号的坚固性与搜索效率结合起来,使每个符号都算数的短文变得理想.

blocks.en: Our method consists of three stages: an offline Codebook Generation step, and online Watermark Embedding and Watermark Extraction steps.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法包括三个阶段:离线代码生成步骤,在线水印嵌入和水印提取步骤。

blocks.en: III-A Codebook Generation
blocks.zh: 三-A 编译本

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Codebook Generation
blocks.zh: 算法 1 代码集生成

blocks.en: The first step, performed offline, is to generate a codebook 𝒞 \mathcal{C} that serves as a shared secret between the embedding and extraction processes. As detailed in Algorithm 1 , the codebook is a map from an n n -bit watermark space to a u u -bit codeword space, where u > n u>n .
blocks.zh: 第一步是线下操作,即生成一个代码簿 C\ mathcal{C},作为嵌入和取出过程之间的共同秘密. 如Algorithm 1所详述,代码本是一幅从n-bit水印空间到u-bit代码字空间的地图,其中u > n > u>n.

blocks.en: Specifically, we generate a table containing 2 n 2^{n} entries. Each entry maps a potential watermark W W (an integer from 0 0 to 2 n − 1 2^{n}-1 ) to a unique binary vector L W L_{W} of length u u . To create this mapping, we use a random linear code over GF ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{GF}(2) : we first derive a random n × u n\times u binary generator matrix 𝐆 \mathbf{G} and a u u -bit offset vector 𝐫 \mathbf{r} from the secret key 𝒦 \mathcal{K} (see Appendix C for details). Each codeword is then computed as L W = bits ⁡ ( W ) ⋅ 𝐆 mod 2 ⊕ 𝐫 L_{W}=\mathrm{bits}(W)\cdot\mathbf{G}\bmod 2\oplus\mathbf{r} , where bits ⁡ ( W ) \mathrm{bits}(W) is the n n -bit binary representation of W W . This process ensures that each message W W corresponds to a unique codeword, and without the secret key 𝒦 \mathcal{K} , the codebook cannot be reconstructed.

blocks.en: The redundancy introduced by making the codeword length u u greater than the message length n n is the key to our scheme’s error resilience and effectiveness. The difference, u − n u-n , can be seen as providing redundancy analogous to parity or check bits in classical error-correcting codes. By expanding each n n -bit message into a u u -bit codeword, we ensure that the valid codewords are, with high probability, far apart from each other in terms of the Hamming or Levenshtein distance. This separation allows us to correctly identify the original watermark even if several bits of the codewords are not encoded properly during generation. The greater the difference u − n u-n , the more errors can be tolerated, improving the chances of perfect watermark recovery. However, the choice of these parameters presents a trade-off: choosing too small of an n n limits the total number of unique watermarks that can be embedded, while choosing too large of a u u requires longer generated texts.

blocks.en: IV Variant with BCH Correction Code
blocks.zh: 四. 与BCH修正法的备选案文

blocks.en: The codebook-based watermarking scheme described in Section III offers high accuracy and robustness for short texts, but it has notable limitations when scaling to larger watermark sizes. For example, with a 32-bit watermark (supporting over 4 billion unique identifiers), the codebook would require storing 2 32 2^{32} entries, which is computationally and memory-intensive during extraction. This makes the codebook approach impractical for very large watermark spaces, as discussed in Section VI .
blocks.zh: 第三节所描述的以代码为主的水印办法为短文本提供了高精度和坚固度,但在缩放到更大的水印尺寸时有显著的局限性. 例如,如果有一个32位水印(支持超过40亿个独特的识别符),代码簿将要求存储2个32 2-^{32}的条目,这在提取过程中是计算和内存密集的. 如第六节所讨论,这使得编码本方法对非常大的水印空间不切实际。

blocks.en: To address this, we introduce a variant that uses a Bose–Chaudhuri–Hocquenghem (BCH) error-correcting code instead of a codebook. The overall workflow remains similar: during encoding, a binary watermark is transformed into a binary codeword using BCH encoding, and this codeword is embedded into the text using the same token-level biasing strategy as in Algorithm 2 . During extraction, the received codeword is decoded using the BCH algorithm to recover the original watermark. Unlike the codebook method, where the Hamming/Levenshtein distance to the closest codeword serves as a confidence metric, here the number of bit flips (i.e., the difference between the retrieved codeword and the codeword reconstructed from the decoded watermark) provides a measure of reliability. This approach avoids the need for a large codebook and enables efficient watermarking for larger payload sizes, at the cost of potentially lower error tolerance compared to the codebook method.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一个使用Bose-Chaudhuri-Hocquenghem(BCH)错误校正代码而不是代码本的变体. 整体工作流程依然相似: 在编码过程中,一个二进制水印会被用 BCH 编码转换成二进制编码字,这个编码字会使用与Algorithm 中相同的同值级偏移策略被嵌入到文本中. 2 (中文(简体) ). 在取出过程中,所接收的密码词被用BCH算法来解码来取回原来的水印. 与编码本方法不同的是,汉明/列文斯提因与最接近的编码字的距离充当了置信度量,这里的比特翻转数(即取回的编码字与从已解码的水印上重建的编码字的区别)提供了可靠性的度量. 这种方法避免了对大型代码簿的需要,并且能够对较大的有效载荷尺寸进行高效的水标记,其代价是可能比代码簿方法更低的容错度。

blocks.en: V-A Extraction Time
blocks.zh: V-A 采掘时间

blocks.en: Extraction consists of decoding the bit sequence from text and searching the codebook for the closest match. Decoding is negligible (tokenization and per-token classification); the bottleneck is the brute-force search over all 2 n 2^{n} entries. The BCH variant bypasses this search entirely via algebraic decoding. Table IV reports the extraction time for n = 24 n{=}24 ( ≈ 16.8 {\approx}16.8 M entries), averaged over 10,000 queries. The Hamming variant uses the Faiss library on CPU with 8 OpenMP threads; the Levenshtein variant uses a custom Triton kernel on the GPU.

blocks.en: Even in the slowest setting, extraction takes under 0.1 seconds—practical for real-time use. For comparison, other methods that reach comparable match rates are orders of magnitude slower for watermarks upwards of 20 bits [ 6 ] .

blocks.en: V-B Quality of Watermarked Texts
blocks.zh: V-B 有水标记的文字质量

blocks.en: Our quality evaluation (Appendix G ) indicates that the watermark has only a modest effect on perceived text quality. In an LLM-as-a-Judge study on review-style and social-post prompts, watermarked outputs were rated similarly to non-watermarked ones and even received a small authenticity preference. Perplexity increases under watermarking, but the values remain moderate. Lexical-diversity analysis further shows that watermarked text is consistently more diverse and less repetitive, suggesting that the bias introduces phrasing variation rather than obvious degradation. Overall, these results support that the watermark preserves readable, socially plausible text while slightly increasing diversity.
blocks.zh: 我们的质量评估(附录G)表明,水印对所感知的文本质量只有微弱的影响. 在一项关于审查式和社会张贴提示的LLM-as-a-Judge研究中,标有水分的产出被评为与非标有水分的产出类似,甚至得到一点真实性的偏好。 在水分标记下,复杂性会增加,但数值仍然中等。 对表征多样性的分析还表明,标有水印的文字始终更加多样,重复性也更少,这表明这种偏见引入了用词变化而不是明显的退化。 总的来说,这些结果支持水印保留可读、社会上可行的文本,同时略微增加多样性。

blocks.en: V-C Attack Robustness
blocks.zh: V-C 攻击强力

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Match rate under attacks, evaluated on generations from Llama 2 7B with the OpenGen dataset [ 10 ] . The attacker’s budget is 10% of a total number of tokens for a given text. Baseline values are estimated from Figure 6 of Qu et al. [ 6 ] .

blocks.en: We consider an attacker whose aim is to remove the watermark and alter the multi-bit payload. The attacker can edit the watermarked text while preserving the semantics and readability.
blocks.zh: 我们认为攻击者的目标是去除水印并改变多位有效载荷. 攻击者可以在保留语义和可读性的同时编辑水印文字.

blocks.en: Because we focus on short texts generated at scale, we exclude attacks that require substantial human effort (e.g., manual rewriting) or heavy paraphrasing by other models. In our regime, a strong global rewrite often replaces most of the surface form and becomes very close to generating a new text with the same intent. An attacker capable of doing this can often bypass watermarking by generating a fresh unwatermarked text directly.
blocks.zh: 因为我们注重于规模生成的短文,我们排除了需要大量人力努力(如人工重写)或由其他模型进行重写的攻击. 在我们的政权中,强有力的全球重写往往取代了大部分表面形式,并非常接近产生具有同样意图的新案文。 有能力这样做的攻击者往往可以通过直接生成新鲜而无水标记的文字来绕过水标记.

blocks.en:
We apply four common attacks:
word insertion, word deletion, substitution with synonyms and paraphrasing (details in Appendix B ). Following a common setting, we modify 10% tokens. Figure 2 shows a comparison between our recommended variant (Levenshtein) and baselines [ 5 , 11 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们使用四种常见的攻击:
字的插入、字的删除、用同义词取而代之和用同义词取而代之(详见附录B)。 按照共同的设定,我们修改了10%的令牌. 图2显示了我们所建议的变种(Levenshtein)和基线[5、11、6]之间的比较。

blocks.en: Our method offers a meaningful level of robustness, particularly against the word deletion and light paraphrasing attacks (10% modified tokens). The word insertion attack is more challenging because it increases the Levenshtein distance to the correct codeword and the extraction algorithm recovers an incorrect watermark more often. Yet, it still achieves nearly 60% match rate.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法提供了有意义的坚固程度,特别是针对去字和光变攻击(10%的修改符号). 单词插入攻击更具挑战性,因为它能将莱文什特因的距离提升到正确的密码字,而取出算法更经常地恢复一个不正确的水印. 然而,它仍然实现了近60%的匹配率。

blocks.en: Hamming and BCH variants are brittle against the considered attacks. This is because they compare codewords bit-by-bit at fixed positions without considering positional shifts. Even a single insertion or deletion causes a frameshift that desynchronizes all subsequent bit comparisons. Therefore, for applications where robustness matters, we recommend a scheme which uses the Levenshtein distance.
blocks.zh: Hamming和BCH的变体对被考虑的攻击是脆弱的。 这是因为他们在固定位置上比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特比特. 即使是一次插入或删除,也会导致帧相变,使所有后续的比特比特比较脱同步. 因此,对于强健性重要的应用,我们建议采用一种使用莱文施泰因距离的方案。

blocks.en: VI Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 限制

blocks.en: A main limitation of our proposed scheme is the size of the codebook, which directly impacts extraction efficiency. While the watermark space, determined by n n , can theoretically be made large (e.g., n = 32 n=32 to support over 4 billion unique watermarks), this creates a practical bottleneck during the extraction phase. The extraction process requires computing a distance between the candidate codeword L ^ \widehat{L} and every codeword L W L_{W} in the codebook 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . For a large n n , this computation becomes prohibitively expensive, undermining the goal of a fast and scalable detection system. Therefore, a trade-off exists between the watermark’s capacity ( 2 n 2^{n} ) and the computational cost of extraction.
blocks.zh: 我们拟议方案的一个主要限制是密码簿的大小,它直接影响了提取效率。 虽然由n n 所决定的水印空间理论上可以变大(例如n = 32 n = 32来支撑超过40亿个独特的水印),但这在取出阶段造成了实用的瓶颈. 提取过程需要计算候选密码词L ^\ gladhat{L}与代码簿 C\mathcal{C}中每个密码词L W L_{W}之间的距离. 对于一个大的nn.,这种计算变得昂贵得令人望而却步,破坏了快速可伸缩的检测系统的目标. 因此,在水印容量(2 n 2^{n)和取出成本之间有取舍。

blocks.en: The limitation can be circumvented by requiring longer texts for embedding a watermark. For example, instead of common 200-token text, we would use 256 tokens. Then, we can easily embed 32-bit watermark by dividing the text into two parts and embedding 16-bit watermark in each part.
blocks.zh: 可以通过要求安装水印的较长文本来规避这一限制。 例如,我们将使用256个符号,而不是普通的200个音标文本。 然后,我们就可以很容易地将32位水印嵌入其中,将文字分为两部分,并在每一部分嵌入16位水印.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We proposed a novel multi-bit watermarking scheme for LLM-generated texts. We showed that for watermark lengths up to 24 bits, our approach can achieve both near-100% match rates and practical extraction speed. For most models, this stays true even for very short, 127-token texts. This makes the method well suited to watermarking short comments, product reviews or social media posts — all potential AI-generated fake content. Our recommended Levenshtein variant offers solid robustness against common attacks. We also investigated other variants that may be preferable when speed is the primary concern (Hamming) or when longer watermarks are required (BCH).
blocks.zh: 我们为LLM生成的文本提出了一个新的多位水标记计划。 我们显示,对于长达24比特的水印, 我们的方法可以实现近100%的匹配率和实际的提取速度。 对于大多数模型来说,即使是非常短的127个音节的文本,这仍然是正确的. 这使得该方法非常适合水上标注短评,产品评论或社交媒体帖子——所有潜在的AI产生的假内容. 我们推荐的Levenshtein变体对普通攻击提供了坚实的防守。 我们还调查了在速度是主要关切(Hammining)或需要更长的水印(BCH)时可能更可取的其他变体.

blocks.en: Appendix B Attack Robustness Setup
blocks.zh: 附录B 攻击强健性设置

blocks.en: The attack robustness experiments in Section V-C apply adversarial modifications at the word level to the watermarked text itself. This reflects a realistic threat model in which an attacker edits the generated text while attempting to preserve its meaning and readability.
blocks.zh: 第五-C节中的攻击强度试验对标有水印的文字本身在字面上采用了对抗性修改. 这反映了一种现实的威胁模式,即攻击者在编辑生成的文本的同时试图保持其意义和可读性.

blocks.en: All four attacks are governed by an attack budget , a fraction of tokens to be affected. Given a watermarked text of length T T tokens (measured by the model’s tokenizer without special tokens), the target number of tokens to modify is B = ⌊ attack_budget ⋅ T ⌋ B=\lfloor\text{attack\_budget}\cdot T\rfloor . In our experiments we set the attack budget to 0.1 (10% of tokens).
blocks.zh: 所有四起攻击都受攻击预算支配, 由于长度为 T 的标有水印的文字(由模型的标注器测量而无特殊符号),修改对象为 B = Q 攻击_ 预算 T = B=\ldle\ text{ 攻击 * 预算 *=cdot 脚踏车 在我们的实验中,我们把攻击预算设定为0.1%(10%的代币).

blocks.en: B- 1 Word deletion
blocks.zh: B - 1 删除单词

blocks.en: The text is split into words by whitespace. The word indices are shuffled uniformly at random and words are deleted one by one, accumulating the token count of each removed word, until the cumulative count reaches or exceeds B B . Because tokens are removed, the decoded bit sequence becomes shorter than u u , causing positional shifts in the remaining bits.
blocks.zh: 文字由白相间分作相. 单词指数以随机方式统一洗牌,并逐个删除单词,累积每个被删除单词的符号数,直到累积数达到或超过B. 由于代号被去掉,解码的比特序列会比u u 更短,导致所剩比特中的位置变化.

blocks.en: B- 2 Word insertion
blocks.zh: B -- 2 个字插入

blocks.en: Random English words are drawn from the NLTK words corpus (approximately 235,000 entries) and inserted at uniformly random positions in the text until the cumulative token count of inserted words reaches B B . Inserted tokens lengthen the decoded bit sequence beyond u u and shift all subsequent bit positions, making this attack particularly challenging for fixed-position distance metrics.
blocks.zh: 随机的英文单词取自NLTK单词体(约235,000个条目)并用统一随机位置插入正文,直到插入单词的累积符号数达到B. 被插入的符使已解码的比特序列长度超过u u,并转移后所有比特位置,使得这次攻击对固定位置相距度量仪尤其具有挑战性.

blocks.en: B- 3 Synonym replacement
blocks.zh: B-3 同义词替换

blocks.en: Words are part-of-speech tagged using the Penn Treebank tagset and mapped to WordNet categories (noun, verb, adjective, adverb). For each word with at least one single-word synonym in WordNet, we record it as a replacement candidate. Candidates are shuffled and replaced one by one with a randomly chosen synonym until the cumulative token count of the original words reaches B B . Unlike deletion and insertion, synonym replacement largely preserves text length, so its primary effect is to alter the decoded bit values at the affected positions without shifting neighbouring bits.
blocks.zh: 单词是用 Penn Treebank 标签集标记并被映射到WordNet 类别(名词,动词,形容词,副词)的部分语句. 对于WordNet中至少有一个单词同义词的每个单词,我们将其记录为替代候选. 候选人被洗牌,用随机选择的同义词取而代之,直到原始词的累积符号数达到B. 与删除和插入不同,同义替换在很大程度上保留了文本长度,因此它的主要效果是在受影响的位置改变已解码的比特值而无需移动相邻比特.

blocks.en: B- 4 Paraphrasing
blocks.zh: B - 4 参数化

blocks.en: A contiguous region of words is selected by choosing a random centre position and expanding alternately left and right until the region spans at least B B tokens. The selected region is sent to a large language model ( GPT-oss-120B via an OpenAI-compatible API) with the instruction: “Rewrite the following text while preserving its meaning. Output only the rewritten text, nothing else.” ( temperature = 0.7 \texttt{temperature}=0.7 ). The paraphrased region replaces the original, while the surrounding prefix and suffix remain unchanged. This attack can simultaneously alter bit values, insert new tokens, and delete existing ones within the affected region.
blocks.zh: 选择一个相接的单词区域是通过选择一个随机中心位置,并在区域至少跨越B个符号之前,将左右相交地扩展. 选定区域通过OpenAI兼容的API发送给一个大型语言模型(GPT-oss-120B),其指令是:“在保留其含义的同时,改写以下文本。 只输出重写文本,别无其他内容。” (温度 = 0.7\ textt{temperature *=0.7). 被解释的区域取代了原作,而周围的前缀和后缀保持不变. 这种攻击可以同时改变位值,插入新的令牌,并删除受影响区域内的现有令牌.

blocks.en: B- 5 Evaluation procedure
blocks.zh: B-5 评价程序

blocks.en: After each attack, the modified text is re-tokenized and decoded using the same green/red token classification as during embedding (Section III ). If the decoded bit sequence exceeds u u bits (which can occur after word insertion, synonym replacement, or paraphrasing), it is truncated to exactly u u bits. The resulting bit sequence is searched against the codebook using the Levenshtein distance, and the watermark identity of the closest codeword is returned. We report the match rate : the fraction of samples for which the recovered watermark equals the originally embedded one.
blocks.zh: 每次攻击后,修改后的案文被重新收录并解码,使用与嵌入时相同的绿色/红色符号分类(第三节.). 如果已解码的比特序列超过u u比特(这可以在词入后发生,同义词替换,或参数化后发生),则被切入到准确的u u比特. 由此产生的比特序列被用莱文什特因相距搜索到代码簿,并返回最接近代码词的水印身份. 我们报告匹配率:回收的水印的样本比例等于原先嵌入的水印。

blocks.en: Appendix F Tokenization Inconsistency Correction
blocks.zh: 附录F 不一致的校正

blocks.en: Subword tokenizers used by modern LLMs are not round-trip stable: decoding a token sequence into text and re-encoding that text can produce a token list of different length [ 14 ] . This phenomenon, known as tokenization inconsistency (TI), arises because the greedy merge rules applied during encoding may segment a string differently when surrounding context changes. Yan and Murawaki [ 14 ] report that while token-level inconsistency rates are typically below 0.3% for Llama 2 7B , the text-level rate—the probability that at least one token in a generated text is affected—reaches 33.6% for 200-token sequences.
blocks.zh: 现代LLMS使用的子词代碼器并不稳定:将一个代号序列解码为文本并重新编码该文本可以生成不同长度的代号列表 [14]. 这种现象被称作象征性的不一致(TI),因为编码时所应用的贪婪的合并规则可能会在周围上下文变化时以不同方式将一串分出. Yan和Murawaki[14]报告说,虽然Llama 2 7B的象征级不一致率一般低于0.3%,但文本级的比率——生成文本中至少一个象征物受到影响的概率——为200个音节的33.6%。

blocks.en: F- 1 Impact on our scheme
blocks.zh: F -- 1 对我们计划的影响

blocks.en: In our watermarking pipeline, the extractor receives text rather than the original token IDs and must retokenize it to recover the embedded codeword. Because each token encodes exactly one bit, a single token insertion or deletion during retokenization shifts all subsequent bit positions. For Hamming distance and BCH decoding, which rely on strict positional alignment, this causes complete desynchronization of the extracted codeword, typically resulting in extraction failure. Levenshtein distance is only marginally affected, as it natively handles insertions and deletions, but the extra edit operations still reduce the effective codeword separation.
blocks.zh: 在我们的水印管道中,取出器接收到文本而不是原始的代号ID,必须重取它来取回嵌入式密码字. 因为每个令牌精确地编码了一比特,所以一个令牌在重接时会插入或删除会转移所有后续的比特位置. 对于依赖严格位置对接的汉明距离和BCH解码,这导致所取代码完全去同步,一般导致取出失败. Levenshtein距离仅受轻微影响,因为它本土处理插入和删除,但额外的编辑操作仍然会减少有效的密码字分离.

After sampling each token s ( t ) s^{(t)} , we verify that the generated sequence ( s ( 0 ) , … , s ( t ) ) (s^{(0)},\dots,s^{(t)}) survives a decode–encode round-trip with the same length. If the check fails, s ( t ) s^{(t)} is excluded by setting its logit to − ∞ -\infty , and a new token is sampled from the remaining distribution. This process repeats until a consistent token is found or a retry limit is reached.

The model’s logits are computed once per token position; retries only mask and resample from the same logit vector. • Length-only check. Each consistency check requires one tokenizer decode and one encode call. On Llama 2 7B the cumulative check time over a 200-token generation averages 139 ms (0.70 ms per token), roughly 1.2% of the total generation time.

blocks.en: We conduct text quality evaluation comparing generated text with and without an embedded watermark. We assess quality along three dimensions: LLM-as-a-Judge pairwise comparison, perplexity, and lexical diversity via word-level distinctness and repetition metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们进行文本质量评价,将生成的文本与嵌入式水印进行比较。 我们按照三个方面评估质量:LLM-as-a-Judge对等比较、复杂度和通过字级差异度和重复度量衡量法的多样性。

blocks.en: G-A LLM-as-a-Judge Pairwise Evaluation
blocks.zh: 法官对等评价

blocks.en: For this evaluation, texts are generated with Mistral 7B Instruct . The non-watermarked baseline uses nucleus sampling ( temperature = 0.6 \texttt{temperature}=0.6 , top_p = 0.9 \texttt{top\_p}=0.9 ) with no logit bias, while the watermarked output uses greedy decoding ( temperature = 0 \texttt{temperature}=0 ) with a logit bias of δ = 6 \delta=6 . For each prompt, the judge receives two anonymised responses side-by-side: one watermarked and one non-watermarked. The positions are randomised per-pair to mitigate position bias. The judge model, Gemma 4 31B IT , is instructed to rate which response is better on the dimension of social authenticity —how believable the text is as a genuine human-written product review or social media post. The LLM judge decides a winner (or a tie), preceded by brief reasoning. Texts were generated using SAR Prompts dataset [ 15 ] , which contains review-style and social-post prompts.
blocks.zh: 为进行这一评价,用Mistral 7B 指示生成文本。 非标注水基线采用核取样(温度=0.6\textt{temperature}=0.6,上_p=0.9\textt{top\_p}=0.9),无对数偏差;而标注水的输出则采用贪婪的解码(温度=0\text{tellt{0),对数偏差为==6\delta=6. 对于每个提示,法官会收到两个并排的匿名回复:一个是水印,一个是非水印. 位置逐一随机排列,以缓解位置偏差. 法官模式Gemma 4 31B IT(Gemma 4 31B IT), LLM裁判决定胜出(或平分),前作简短推理. 文本是使用SAR Points数据集[15]生成的,该数据集包含审查式和社交提示。

blocks.en: Table VI reports the results for two codeword lengths ( u = 127 u=127 and u = 200 u=200 ). The two conditions receive very similar ratings, with a slight bias toward the watermarked text at both lengths. The margin is modest—roughly 9 percentage points at u = 127 u=127 and 10 percentage points at u = 200 u=200 —and the tie rate is non-negligible, especially at u = 127 u=127 .
blocks.zh: 表六报告两个代词长度(u=127 u=127和u=200 u=200)的结果. 这两个条件得到的评分非常相近,对标有水印的文字在两种长度上都略有偏差. 相差不大——以u=127u=127分为9个百分点,以u=200u=200分为10个百分点——平分率不可忽略,特别是以u=127u=127分为一分.

blocks.en: A plausible explanation for this small difference is that the logit bias pushes the model away from its most probable tokens, introducing slightly more variation in phrasing that the judge occasionally reads as marginally less recognisably AI-generated.
blocks.zh: 这一小差异的一个合理解释是,逻辑偏差使模型远离了最可能的迹象,在措辞上引入了稍多的变异,即法官偶尔会读作略小的不太被承认的AI生成.

blocks.en: Manual inspection of the judge’s reasoning supports this interpretation. In the majority of comparisons the judge describes the two responses as broadly equivalent, often labelling the winner only “slightly” better. Across both conditions, the most common criticism is that both texts read like “generic marketing copy” or “AI-generated product descriptions” rather than genuine human reviews. The watermarked text occasionally wins by adopting a more conversational or first-person tone, while the non-watermarked text is sometimes faulted for overly formal or “corporate” phrasing. Overall, the judge perceives the two conditions as close in quality, with the watermark producing a small but consistent edge in perceived authenticity.
blocks.zh: 人工检查法官的推理支持这种解释。 在大多数比较中,法官将两种答复描述为大致相当,往往只给胜者贴上“略好”的标签。 从这两个条件来看,最常见的批评是,这两个文本都读作“通用营销副本”或“AI生成的产品描述”,而不是真正的人类评论。 标有水字的文字偶尔会取胜,会采用更会说话或第一人称的语气来取胜,而非标有水字的文字有时会因过于正式或"公司"的用词而出错. 总的来说,法官认为这两个条件在质量上是相近的,水印在所感知的真实性上产生出一个小而一致的边缘.

blocks.en: G-B Perplexity Evaluation
blocks.zh: G-B 复杂性评价

blocks.en: Fig. 8: Perplexity distribution for 200-token Llama 2 7B generations on the OpenGen dataset. Evaluator: Gemma 4 31B .

blocks.en:
We report perplexity only because it is customary in watermarking papers, but we complement it with other quality metrics, which are more reliable and better suited.
Prior work has shown that likelihood-oriented decoding can produce bland or repetitive text, and that decoding strategy alone can strongly affect text quality. More directly, [ 16 ] argue that perplexity from pretrained language models is unreliable for evaluating text quality, especially for short texts.
blocks.zh:
我们报告困惑性只是因为它在水标记文件中是习惯性的,但我们用其他质量标准来补充它,这些标准更可靠,更适合。
先前的工作表明,以可能性为导向的解码可以产生模糊的或重复的文本,而解码策略单是解码策略会强烈地影响文本质量. 更直接地说,[16]认为,从预先训练的语言模型中产生的迷惑性对于评价文本质量是不可靠的,特别是对于短文本而言.

blocks.en: For this evaluation, texts are generated with Llama 2 7B . We evaluate perplexity on 200-token texts on the OpenGen dataset [ 10 ] . Both conditions produced approximately 7,000 generations. Token-level perplexity is computed with a sliding-window approach using the Gemma 4 31B evaluator model. Figure 8 shows the distributions. Non-watermarked text achieves a median perplexity of 4.22 (mean 4.48), while watermarked text reaches 9.58 (mean 9.91)—roughly a two-fold increase. This increase is expected: the logit bias deliberately pushes the generator away from its most probable tokens, which raises perplexity. The absolute values remain moderate, and the relative increase is comparable to that reported by Qu et al. [ 6 ] for the same bias.
blocks.zh: 为进行这一评价,用Llama 2 7B生成文本。 我们评价OpenGen数据集上200个文本的模糊性。 这两种条件产生了大约7000代. 使用Gemma 4 31B评价模型,采用滑窗方法计算出托肯层的复杂度。 图8显示了分布情况。 非水上标注文本的中位费为4.22(平均值为4.48),而水上标注文本为9.58(平均值为9.91)——大约增加了两倍。 这种增加是预期的:对数偏差故意使生成器远离其最可能的信使,这引起了困惑. 绝对值保持不变,相对增加的数值与Qu等人报告的数值相当。 [6] 对于同样的偏见。

blocks.en: G-C Diversity Evaluation
blocks.zh: G-C 多样性评价

blocks.en: We measure diversity with word-level lexical diversity metrics: Distinct-1 (unique unigrams over total unigrams), Distinct-2 (unique bigrams over total bigrams), and Trigram Repetition Rate ( 1 − unique / total 1-\text{unique}/\text{total} trigrams). Higher Distinct scores indicate more varied vocabulary; lower Trigram Repetition Rate indicates less repetition. All metrics are computed with a lightweight CPU script that tokenises text at word boundaries and requires no model or GPU.
blocks.zh: 我们用词级的词性多样性度量法衡量多样性:分化-1(独一克比总单克),分化-2(独一大克比总大克)和三克重现率(1−独一克/总计1-\text{unique}/\text{tot}三克). 更高的分数表示词汇差异较大;下三克重写率表示重复较少. 所有度量衡都是用一个轻量级的CPU脚本来计算,该脚本以字段边界来表示文字,不需要模型或GPU.

blocks.en: Figures 6 and 7 show the distributions for Llama 2 7B ( ≈ \approx 7,000 texts per variant) and Mistral 7B Instruct ( ≈ \approx 150 texts per variant), respectively. In both cases the watermarked text is consistently more diverse and less repetitive.
blocks.zh: 图6和图7分别显示Llama 2 7B(每个变体约7 000个文本)和Mistral 7B 的分布情况(每个变体约150个文本)。 在这两种情况下,标有水印的文本始终更为多样并较少重复。

blocks.en: These results confirm that the logit bias does not merely raise perplexity—it actively increases lexical variety. By steering the model away from its most probable tokens, the watermark produces less repetitive, more idiosyncratic phrasing. This explains both the higher perplexity reported above and the slight authenticity edge observed in the LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这些结果证实,逻辑偏差不仅会增加迷惑性,而且会积极增加词汇种类。 通过使模型远离最可能的迹象,水印产生较少的重复性,更典型的用词. 这既解释了上文报告的更复杂之处,也说明了在LLM-as-a-Judge评价中观察到的略微真实的边缘。

Prompt: British army forces in North America were primarily tied up with the Siege of Boston in 1775. Seeking bases of operations where they had more control, the British planned an expedition to the southern colonies. Major General Henry Clinton, then in Boston, was to travel to Cape Fear, North Carolina, where he would join with largely Scottish Loyalists raised in the North Carolina backcountry, and a force of 2,000 men from Ireland under the command of Major General Charles Cornwallis. The plan was beset by difficulties from the start. The Irish expedition, originally supposed to depart at the beginning of December 1775, was delayed by logistical difficulties, and its 2,500 troops did not depart until February 13, 1776, escorted by 11 warships under the command of Admiral Sir Peter Parker. Clinton left Boston on January 20 with two companies of light infantry, and first stopped at New York City to confer with William Tryon, New York’s royal governor. Major General Charles Lee, sent by Major General George Washington to see to the defense of New York, coincidentally arrived there the same day as Clinton. New York was at that time extremely tense; Patriot forces were beginning to disarm and evict Loyalists, and the British fleet anchored there was having difficulty acquiring provisions. Despite this, Clinton made no secret that his final target was in the south. Lee observed that this was "certainly a droll way of proceeding; to communicate his full plan to the enemy is too novel to be credited." This was not even the first notice of the expedition to the colonists; a letter intercepted in December had already provided intelligence that the British were planning to go to the South. Clinton arrived at Cape Fear on March 12, expecting to find the European convoy already there. He met with the royal governors of North and South Carolina, Josiah Martin and William Campbell, and learned that the recruited Scottish Loyalists had been defeated at Moore’s Creek Bridge two weeks earlier. Clinton also received pleas for assistance from the royal governor of Georgia, James Wright, who had been arrested, and then escaped to a navy ship. Parker’s fleet had an extremely difficult crossing. Battered by storms and high seas, the first ships of the fleet did not arrive at Cape Fear until April 18, and Cornwallis did not arrive until May 3. Some fellow pupils became hostile, though he says they were just trying to "have a crack at the kid that plays Harry Potter" rather than acting out of jealousy. As his acting career began to consume his schedule, Radcliffe continued his education through on-set tutors. He admitted he was not a very good student, considering school useless and finding the work "really difficult". He achieved A grades in the three AS-level exams that he took in 2006, but decided to take a break from education and did not go to college or university. Part of his reasoning was that he already knew he wanted to act and write, and that it would be difficult to have a normal college experience. "The paparazzi, they’d love it", he told Details magazine in 2007. "If there were any parties going on, they’d be tipped off as to where they were." blocks.en: Prompt: On the first night Lead Belly and his wife Martha spent in the city, they encountered racially discriminatory Jim Crow laws similar to those found in their native Louisiana: most hotels refused to rent rooms to African Americans and the few that would were either full or refused to serve him because he was with a white man (Lomax). Lomax, in some versions of the story described as an unnamed "white friend", offered to let the couple stay for the night in his apartment near the Supreme Court Building. The next morning, Lead Belly awoke to Lomax arguing with his landlord about the presence of a black man, with the landlord threatening to call the police. While in Washington, Lead Belly encountered several other incidents of segregation that are believed to have contributed to the impetus of the song. For instance, when Lead Belly, Lomax, and their wives wanted to go out to dinner together, they discovered that it was impossible for the mixed race group to find a restaurant that would serve them. Lead Belly was told that if he returned later without Lomax, he would be served. In response to one of these incidents, a friend of Lead Belly’s, variously identified as either Lomax or Mary Elizabeth Barnicle joked that Washington was a "bourgeois town." Though Lead Belly did not know what the word "bourgeois" meant, he was fascinated by the sound of it, and after its meaning was explained to him he decided to incorporate it into a song about the trip. The song came together quickly; one account claims that it only took a few hours for Lead Belly to write it. Lomax liked it because it was partly based on what happened in his apartment. "The Bourgeois Blues" is a blues-style protest song that criticizes the culture of Washington, DC. It protests against both the city’s Jim Crow laws and the racism of its white population. Its structure includes several verses and a refrain that declares that the speaker is going to "spread the news all around" about the racial issues plaguing the city. The song, particularly in the refrain, conflates race and economics by referring to Caucasians as "bourgeois". Generation: The lyrical structure of the refrain is based upon that of "The House of the Rising Sun" by English musician Eric B. King (1898–?). Lead Belly’s version is the only known instance of the song being performed with a refrain, and it has since been performed with the lyrics of "Birmingham Sunday", a song written by Hudie Ledbetter (Lead Belly) in the 1860s. In addition to its lyrical structure, "The Bourgeois Blues" is also musically similar to "The Rising of the Sun" (or the "Rising Sun" Blues) written in 1899. blocks.en: Prompt: After two straight second-place finishes at Charlotte and Riverside, Richmond started the Pocono event in third place inside the second row. That race saw a caution for rain with five laps left before the halfway point. NASCAR wanted the cars to get to the halfway point to make the race official, so the sanctioning body had the drivers slowly circle the track. It took the drivers 26 minutes to complete the laps, and the rain was so heavy that some drivers had to look out their side windows because they could not see out their windshields. Two hours later, the track had dried and the race resumed with Richmond in third. After Richmond’s car was adjusted to remove the "push", the car was more to his liking. Because his radio did not work, he was unable to communicate with his crew chief, Hyde, and he made his final pit stop with 37 laps left. Hyde worried that Richmond had stopped a lap too early to ensure that he would have enough fuel to make it to the end. After Richmond took the lead with 30 laps left in the race, Dale Earnhardt made up three seconds on Richmond’s five-second lead. With four laps to go, Buddy Arrington spun in a three-car accident. The remaining laps of the race where completed slowly under caution and Richmond took the checkered flag for the victory. He had led 97 laps, including the final 30, taking his first victory in a Rick Hendrick car. The tour returned to Pocono a month later, and Richmond battled for another victory in a fog-shortened event. In the final 8-lap sprint, Richmond competed in a three-car battle with Geoff Bodine and Ricky Rudd. Richmond crossed the finish line beside Rudd, winning the race by 0.05 seconds. He notched four more victories that season, and over a span of twelve races, Richmond earned three second-place finishes, and six wins. The National Motorsports Press Association named him Co-Driver of the Year with Earnhardt after Richmond accumulated 13 top 5 finishes and 16 in the top 10. He had a career-best third-place finish in points after winning seven events in 1986, in what was his last full NASCAR season. Generation: He was the first driver to win the Winston Millions, a 34-race series, in the 30-race schedule. ## 1993 and later years Richmond was named the Grand Marshal for the inaugural 1993 Daytona 500. He had a strong run, and finished in the top 5, but was disallowed a top five finish after the crew chief made an unapproved pitstop. The gameplay originated with a tech demo by Naka, who developed an algorithm allowing a sprite to move smoothly on a curve by determining its position with a dot matrix. Naka’s prototype was a platform game with a fast-moving character rolling in a ball through a long, winding tube, and this concept was fleshed out with Ohshima’s character designs and levels by Yasuhara. Yasuhara originally intended to work on the game for three months due to the delay of his planned move to the United States by the outbreak of the Gulf War, but was engrossed in the project for nearly a year. His designs for levels were intended to attract both hardcore and casual gamers by integrating occasional challenging set pieces into the mostly accessible level design. The color scheme was influenced by the work of pop artist Eizin Suzuki, and the aesthetics of Green Hill were influenced by the geography of California. In designing the gameplay, Naka was inspired by Mario creator Shigeru Miyamoto, whose games he had enjoyed playing years earlier. Admiring the simplicity of Miyamoto’s mechanics in complex environments, Naka decided that Sonic would be controlled with only a directional pad for movement and a single button for jumping. He also wanted his creation to be more action-oriented than the Mario series; while playing Super Mario Bros., he had wondered why the levels could not be cleared more quickly. Naka, Ohshima, and Yasuhara worked 19 hours a day on the project for several months. Due to the need to demonstrate the Genesis’ technological prowess, the game underwent extensive testing and redesign, which took over six months. According to Naka, the game had the fastest-ever character speed in a video game and a rotation effect in the special stages that had been considered impossible on the console. The team intended to add a two-player mode displayed via split-screen, but Naka’s programming knowledge was insufficient to implement it. A two-player mode appeared in Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (1992), whereby the second player controls Sonic’s sidekick Miles "Tails" Prower.
